quote.text: I beseech you, in the bowels of Christ, think it possible you may be mistaken.
quote.author: Oliver Cromwell, letter to the General Assembly of the Church of Scotland, 3 August 1650

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Baking Tins And Sheet Pans
stories.headline: Nordic Ware’s test-winning half sheet is 20 gauge, like Winco’s cheapest
stories.dek: Vollrath and Lloyd Pans sell professionals the same pan at 18 gauge — 0.040 inch of aluminium — and the Minneapolis pan that wins every home test survives instead on an encapsulated galvanised rim.

stories.headline: Anthropic files to list on Nasdaq and leaves its compute commitment blank
stories.dek: The S-1 gives first-half revenue as US$16.3bn and a first operating profit of US$1.0bn in the June quarter — then prints “aggregate committed spend of more than” a dollar sign with no figure after it.

stories.headline: Infrared stove imports rose 204 per cent in Nepal in two months
stories.dek: Customs data for mid-July to mid-September count 41,229 infrared plates against 19,508 induction — because Nepali kitchens cook in round-bottomed aluminium that an induction coil physically cannot see, so a country is electrifying through the less efficient appliance.

stories.headline: Lula wins Brazil’s run-off; Flávio Bolsonaro refuses to concede
stories.dek: The electoral court’s count gives Lula 51.79 per cent against 48.21 — 4,430,191 votes — and the loser will petition to annul a two-hour polling extension that his own campaign had also asked for.

stories.headline: Jakarta puts the gas cut at eight per cent, Singapore at two
stories.dek: Bahlil Lahadalia told reporters on Monday not to lecture Indonesia about honouring contracts — and Singapore’s own two statements, four days apart, measure the same “less than two per cent” against two different denominators.

stories.headline: Apple gives only the 512GB iPad mini a second Neural Engine
stories.dek: The S$999 base model gets five CPU cores and one engine; Apple publishes no refresh rate for the new OLED panel at all, and Singapore pre-orders open at 1.10am on Thursday.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Aquis Kelp Forest
stories.headline: Oris prices the Aquis Kelp Forest at US$2,950; two outlets print less
stories.dek: Oris’s own site says two thousand nine hundred and fifty dollars; Fratello reports 2,450 Swiss francs; and one magazine prints £2,250 in its body copy and the franc figure in its own spec box, in the same article.

stories.headline: Rotten Tomatoes has Clayface at 76 per cent; Metacritic has 59
stories.dek: The same corpus of 44 critics holds a 20 from Rolling Stone and four separate 80s; the film opened to US$24m from 3,458 theatres, and LAIKA’s 99-per-cent Wildwood came third behind it.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Band Problem
stories.headline: Frontiers in Pediatrics splits the screen-and-ADHD odds: 2.40 under six, 1.16 over
stories.dek: Zhao and colleagues pooled ten studies and 232,125 children on 28 September; the headline odds ratio of 1.56 sits on heterogeneity of 97.4 per cent, and the alarming figure belongs entirely to toddlers.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Eve Of The FOMC
stories.headline: The Treasury ten-year closed at exactly 5.00% on the eve of the FOMC
stories.dek: The ten-year breakeven has not moved from 2.34% since Friday, which leaves a real yield of 2.66%; one monitor prices Wednesday’s hold at 88.5 per cent, and the CME’s own tool refused this desk for a second day.

stories.headline: Greg Blonder measured a brisket stalling at 153°F for almost six hours
stories.dek: A retired Bell Labs physicist ruled out rendering fat and melting collagen by experiment: the stall is evaporative cooling, the meat behaving as a wet-bulb thermometer — and wrapping cuts a pork shoulder from almost fourteen hours to about ten.

stories.headline: Granada’s TEMPUS trial finds time-restricted eating no better than usual care
stories.dek: Nature Communications published the four-arm trial on 14 October: 187 adults, twelve weeks, and the eight-hour window moved liver fat by −0.4 per cent against usual care, at p equals 0.93 — with no competing interests declared.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Three Dates That Close
stories.headline: Singapore’s 2027 Grand Prix opens regular ticket sales on 11 November
stories.dek: Early Bird has already gone across every grandstand, per the organiser’s own 5 October stamp; ART SG’s half-price pass expires on 24 November, and the January sumo basho in Tokyo opens its advance sale on 5 December.
